narrative.overview: FindWorks feels like a well-kept operational record: calm enough for sustained work and structured enough that state and next action are never ambiguous. The dark navigation frame establishes place; cool paper and white working surfaces keep content legible under ordinary office lighting.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but readable ledgers rather than galleries of equal cards
Fine rules and tonal layers for structure
One clear next action per row

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies interaction; warm hues identify attention. Do not scatter either color decoratively.

rules.name: The Parent Context Rule
rules.body: A Mission row always names its Discovery. Detail pages retain both global navigation and a local breadcrumb.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use dividers and whitespace first. Add elevation only where a bounded working surface must separate from the page.

dos: Do show lifecycle state and the next action together.
Do keep Discovery context visible anywhere Missions or findings are listed.
Do use flat rows and rules when content needs comparison.
Do preserve a focused, shell-free experience for external Interviewees.
donts: Don't create dead navigation destinations or placeholder dashboard modules.
Don't use a grid of equal metric cards as the dashboard’s primary structure.
Don't use warm attention color for ordinary decoration.
Don't hide required mobile navigation behind horizontal scrolling.
